clips.prompt: Painterly, cinematic 3D animation like a high-quality animated historical film, warm candlelight, soft film look. Evening in 1839 in a plain wooden room of a Hamburg children's home. Children in plain 19th-century clothes gather under a big wooden wagon wheel hanging from the ceiling; on it stand four big white candles and many small red candles. A young man in a dark 19th-century coat lights one more small red candle with a long taper while the children sing softly; the room glows warmer. Slow camera push in.
clips.credit: Made with Google Veo

clips.prompt: Painterly, cinematic 3D animation like a high-quality animated historical film, warm candlelight, soft film look. Winter in the 1880s, a simple farmhouse kitchen in Swabia with frost on the small window. A mother in a plain 19th-century dress lays small round biscuits one by one on a large piece of cardboard on the wooden table; her son, about six years old, in a woollen jumper, watches eagerly and counts on his fingers.
clips.credit: Made with Google Veo

clips.prompt: Same visual style as the reference image: painterly, cinematic 3D animation like a high-quality animated historical film, warm candlelight, soft film look. Early 1900s, a small print shop in Munich. A young man in a waistcoat with rolled-up sleeves pulls a freshly printed sheet off a hand press: a colourful grid of 24 little Christmas pictures. He holds it up to the window light and smiles proudly. Dust in the air, warm light.
clips.credit: Made with Google Veo
clips.note: 0-2 s shows the same man twice at the press; cut from 2 s.
